title: label left default vs top
rule: Ant: label left of input by default; top when the text is too long or in English context; consistent within the system. Dual-cite Fluent/Spectrum top-default. Do not pick a winner.
pass_when: Labels are consistently left or consistently top in-product (Ant left-default; Fluent/Spectrum top-default). Ant also allows top when label text is too long or in English context.
fail_when: Mixed left/top in one form with no reason; or a house default that bans the other cite.
overview: Form labels sit left by default; top when text is long or English.
apply_when: Placing field labels in Ant forms across a product.
not_when: Forcing one cite to ban Fluent/Spectrum top-default labels.
agent_hint: Keep label side consistent; Ant left-default, top when long or English.
description: Ant places labels left of inputs by default and moves them above when the label text is too long or the product is English-context; whatever you choose, stay consistent in-product. Fluent and Spectrum default top instead — treat that as a dual-cite, not a winner to enforce. Fail mixed left/top in one form with no reason, or a house rule that bans the other cite’s default.
do_not_claim: A house left-or-top winner; GOV.UK sentence-case/no-colons as this placement row. Overlap with extra 73: `fluent.labels-top-aligned-by-default`. Overlap with Forms 54: beyond LIVE `visible_label` / `label_stays_visible`.
